purpose: Give world-challenge Blueprints one atomic, idempotent route to canonical completion and reward intents.

authority.runtime_attempt: BP_MelodiaWorldChallenge child; transient attempt state only
authority.save_write: canonical save contract owned by UMelodiaNarrativeSubsystem

transient_attempt_surface.begin: BP-local BeginAttempt after shared capability gate allows the request
transient_attempt_surface.reset: BP-local discard of uncommitted attempt state
transient_attempt_surface.persistence_rule: never write attempt progress to FMelodiaNarrativeRecord

preflight: BP verifies an allowed shared capability-gate result using GateRequestId and EvaluationFingerprint before calling this adapter
validate completion flag and reward against existing narrative allowlists
reject inconsistent prior flag/reward/intent combinations before mutation
post_commit_events: return applied result with one evaluation fingerprint
commit_transaction.rollback_rule: if any preflight check fails, change no canonical field and emit no reward event
commit_transaction.replay_rule: the same CompletionIntentId returns already_applied without another flag or reward mutation

allowed: hold attempt progress in transient variables
present preview, blocked, available, or completed state
forbidden: call SetNarrativeFlag and GrantDialogueReward as separate unsynchronized completion steps
grant a reward before committed completion
persist attempt progress as if it were completion
create a challenge-specific save object or GameMode

gate_boundary.bp_obligation: re-evaluate the shared capability gate on enter, context/progression/load/travel/reset changes and forward only an allowed result
gate_boundary.native_obligation: validate canonical IDs and commit atomically; do not claim to re-evaluate an uncompiled gate registry
gate_boundary.promotion_requirement: fresh evidence envelope contains GateRequestId, EvaluationFingerprint, and the matching native commit result

promotion_evidence: blocked or invalid request leaves the record byte-equivalent
first commit changes flag/intent/reward exactly once
duplicate commit is already_applied with no second reward
fixture route records the gate and transaction fingerprints
